about: The one definition of each language the site itself can be read in (the header's language menu), read by the site through site-languages.ts and by the Python and Node tools directly. Read it as UTF-8 (Python: open(path, encoding='utf-8')). Translation system, stage 3 (SiteTranslation/system/HANDOFF.md).
Not the 140 languages of the site's Bibles: those are languages.ts.
Order is the menu's order. Every field is required; site-languages-check.ts refuses an unknown field or a bad value, and src/lib/site-languages.test.ts runs it.
code: the web standard tag (BCP 47), as in <html lang> and Intl: 'pt-BR'.
folder: the translated copy's folder under data/i18n/ and the tools' language name: 'pt'. null only for English, the source language, which has no copy.
bible: the site's id of the Bible this language quotes unless the reader chooses another (data/plain/<bible>/). null: it quotes the source language's Bible (a made-up test language has none).
name: the menu's name, in the language itself. englishName: its name in English, for briefs and reports.
plurals: the plural categories Intl.PluralRules gives this code (cardinal); Arabic has six, Chinese one.
digits: the Unicode numbering system the site shows numbers in ('latn' = 0-9 in every language today).
font: the font stack index.css gives text marked with this language (verses); the site's own labels keep the site's typefaces in every language. null: no rule of its own.
released: whether the language goes out with a release (scripts/release-translations.ts); an unreleased one appears in the menu only on this computer's preview.
pseudo: a made-up test language generated by a script (SiteTranslation/system/pseudo_language.py, from the catalog; en-XA left to right, ar-XB right to left); it can never be released.
